viet-crispwich: Y’all hear that crunch? 👀😋 Make Viet Crispwich our new go to! We tried thier Shredded Chicken Bánh Mì, fried pork dumplings, Premium Spicy Chilli Broth Noodles! Everything was sooo flavorful and crispy. Def worth a try! Fun fact: they also manage Viet House
viet-house: Best pho in Huntsville 🍜… yeah, we said it. & under $40 for all this! Viet House is our forever fav 🤍 We lowkey end up here almost every week—and for good reason. If you don’t know what to order, take ours: • Fried Spring Rolls to start • Chicken Pho (level 1 if you want it a lil spicy, level 3 if you like it HOT like me 😉🔥) Arrington always gets the large and I always get a small. Simple, flavorful, and always hits every time.
vujee-vegan: Vegan or not? 👀🌱Vujee Vegan is a must try! We tried sooo much — A Cheeze burger, Philly Egg Rolls, Chick’n Nuggets, the Buffalo “chick’n ” sandwich, and that CHILI?? 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ the punch, lemonade and waffles fries we so good! If you think you don’t like vegan food… this might change your mind. If you go def get our favs from our taste test: Chili and buffalo chick’n sandwich! 😋 4701 Meridian St N, Huntsville, AL 35811 Tuesday–Saturday 11 AM–7 PM
west-end-grill: You been in Huntsville how long and haven’t been yet? West End Grill is a Huntsville staple, and we definitely think it’s worth a visit! What we ordered (under $60): ⭐️ Galaxy Lemonade with gin & curaçao 🔥 Loaded potato skins (new item) with the homemade ranch 🍔 Patty melt & eye bread 🍗 Jamaican jerk wings & lemon pepper wings And shoutout to Darrell for being a great server!
willie-bs-nashville: Buffalo chicken mac & cheese at 1am? Why not! Check out Willie B’s Kitchen & Lounge in Nashville for late night food & vibes, it was as good as it looks 🤤
wings-and-gyros: Wings & Gyros 🔥🍗🔥 We now have a new wing spot as our go-to!! They gotta be some of the best wings in Huntsville— no lie!!
